rationale: John brings deep expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and ML ops while Alex is actively building fullstack skills through machine learning bootcamp—John's conviction that agentic AI is the frontier aligns with where Alex is investing learning time. As a National Executive Advisor at Code and Coffee, John mentors on cloud computing and AI/ML, making him a natural guide for Alex's transition from student to practitioner in the ML and cloud-native space.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Alex — Alex is a fullstack developer in the Sacramento/SF area going deep on machine learning, and John leads infrastructure and AI/ML initiatives at Cloudfitters while advising the Code and Coffee developer community.
